entities.summary: Alice Mildred Cable was a British Protestant Christian missionary in China, serving with the China Inland Mission. Cable was part of an inseparable "trio" of missionaries along with sisters Francesca and Eva French. The trio is best known for their missionary efforts along remote caravan routes in Central Asia and the Gobi Desert.
